atom: QG-41: does the existence/selection separation hold on a materially different compiler family?

cross_family_picture.Qiskit_layout_QG40: existence NOT free (cruder summary), selection impossible
cross_family_picture.SixLCU: existence FREE, selection impossible, SHAPE determined
cross_family_picture.conclusion: selection failure is generic across all three; existence-freeness is NOT generic -- it holds exactly when the summary is the maximal symmetry quotient, which C1 established for TARE and which a degree sequence is not

family: SixLCU (PREP/SELECT LCU), reconstructed from qg4_second_family on origin/main
